overall_assessment: Section boundaries and the three learning-outcome groups are generally preserved across all 17 packet courses, but pointer-only sections, residual coursework in assessment, and examiner logistics need cleanup. The duplicate/short flags on study-plan pointers expose invalid placeholder rows rather than extractor-created duplication; long practice activities and short prerequisite course codes are valid, while course-content/learning-outcome leak flags mostly match assessment sublabels rather than merged sections. All three controls retain examiner logistics, so that issue extends beyond the suspects; comparisons are limited to the full text actually supplied in the packet, whose builder caps several plans.

findings.evidence: Se avsnittet «Arbeids-, lærings- og vurderingsformer» i studieplanens generelle del.
findings.description: Eight of 17 courses emit sections containing only a pointer to the general study plan. Both VUBHP offerings emit the same pointer as course_content, learning_outcomes and teaching_methods; six further courses emit a pointer-only teaching_methods row. These rows contain no substantive section text and should be absent under course_plan_spec.md. The duplication and boilerplate flags therefore identify placeholder retention, not copied substantive content or missing text demonstrable in this packet.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R .placeholder_phrases handles simple study-plan pointers but does not cover the possessive wording studieplanens generelle del or the Se avsnittet formulation.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend whole-section placeholder matching to the two exact recurring DMMH pointer formulations, including optional final punctuation. Drop rows consisting solely of these pointers; preserve rows containing additional substantive text.

findings.description: Assessment retains explicit coursework gates and equivalence rules in at least five courses (BLPRA100, BFPRA200, BKKKK1013, BFLSU3053 and BHFOR3561). Examples include PL1/PF2 requirements before placement, the malformed BKKKK exam-access heading and its requirement codes, and equivalence blocks. In BHFOR3561 the MUN1 gate moves to coursework_requirements but OPG1: F-TF1 og F-TF4 remains in assessment after an intervening exam-description paragraph. Thus coursework_requirements loses part of the gate information even when the main requirement table is extracted correctly. Mandatory activities explicitly forming a graded practical exam are valid assessment content and are not the defect.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: DMMH has no section_inline_coursework configuration in R/institution_config.R. R/extract_sections.R .split_inline_coursework moves recognized gate sentences but misses malformed gate leads, placement-start conditions, equivalence labels and separated continuation rows.
findings.suggested_fix: Enable bounded inline coursework-block recognition for DMMH and add explicit matches for the recurring placement-start, malformed exam-access and equivalence headings. Use known exam and arbeidskrav codes to move gate-reference rows, including OPG1 after intervening assessment prose, without moving descriptions of graded exam activities.

findings.description: Every sampled assessment, including all three random controls, retains Sensorordning examiner-arrangement rows. These are explicitly excluded logistics under course_plan_spec.md, even though exam form, duration, weights, grading scale and permitted aids belong in assessment. The practice courses also retain recurring examiner-role and resubmission/deadline procedures. This is recurring noise inside otherwise useful assessment text, not a reason to discard the assessment tables.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The DMMH reader keeps the narrow assessment tables under Vurderinger, while R/extract_sections.R lacks DMMH-specific cleanup for labelled Sensorordning rows and recurring assessment-logistics prose.
findings.suggested_fix: In section cleanup, remove complete Sensorordning label/value rows, handling both tab-separated and separate-line values. Add bounded DMMH rules for standalone examiner-role and resubmission/deadline notices while retaining sentences describing assessment criteria or design and all duration/aids fields.

findings.evidence: Mangelfull tilstedeværelse i undervisningen kan gjøre det nødvendig å foreta en skjønnsmessig vurdering av om studenten kan tilbys praksisplass.
findings.description: The entire prerequisites row is an explanation of teaching attendance and possible refusal of a practice placement. It specifies no required or recommended subject knowledge or prior course. The long flag therefore exposes a semantic misclassification rather than merely an unusually long legitimate prerequisite.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Forkunnskapskrav is mapped directly to prerequisites, and the prerequisite cleaner does not recognize this attendance/placement-access wording.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a narrowly scoped DMMH rule for this recurring attendance paragraph: keep the pedagogical explanation in teaching_methods and the explicit placement-access attendance condition in coursework_requirements, removing the resulting empty prerequisites row. Continue retaining genuine prerequisite course-code lists.
